name: Claude 4 Sonnet
description: Balanced model offering strong performance at a moderate price.
longDescription: Claude 4 Sonnet strikes the ideal balance between intelligence and speed. It excels at complex coding, reasoning, and content tasks while maintaining fast response times, making it the go-to model for most production applications.
limitations: Less capable than Opus on hardest tasks

codeSnippets.code:
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
message = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-4-sonnet-20250301",
    max_tokens=1024,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(message.content[0].text)
